description: A CLI task tracker with local JSON storage, CRUD operations, and filtering
non_goals: No cloud sync or multi-user support
No recurring tasks or calendar integration

userStories.title: Initialize project with test harness
userStories.description: Set up the project structure, dependencies, and test framework so subsequent stories can run quality gates
acceptance_criteria: package.json exists with project name and version
TypeScript is configured (tsconfig.json)
Jest or Vitest is configured and a sample test passes
npm test runs without error
npm run build produces output without error

userStories.title: Add a task via CLI
userStories.description: User can add a new task with a title from the command line
acceptance_criteria: Running `task add "Buy groceries"` creates a task in tasks.json
Each task has: id (auto-increment), title, status (default: 'todo'), createdAt (ISO timestamp)
If tasks.json doesn't exist, it's created automatically
A confirmation message is printed: 'Task added: Buy groceries (id: 1)'

userStories.title: List all tasks
userStories.description: User can see all their tasks in a formatted table
acceptance_criteria: Running `task list` prints all tasks in a readable table format
Table shows: ID, Status, Title, Created date
If no tasks exist, prints 'No tasks yet. Use `task add` to create one.'
Tasks are sorted by ID ascending

userStories.title: Mark a task as done
userStories.description: User can mark a task complete by its ID
acceptance_criteria: Running `task done 2` sets task 2's status to 'done'
A confirmation message is printed: 'Task 2 marked as done'
If the ID doesn't exist, prints an error: 'Task not found: 2'
If already done, prints: 'Task 2 is already done'

userStories.title: Filter tasks by status
userStories.description: User can list only tasks matching a given status
acceptance_criteria: Running `task list --status todo` shows only todo tasks
Running `task list --status done` shows only done tasks
Invalid status prints: 'Invalid status. Use: todo, done'
No flag shows all tasks (existing behavior from US-003)
